description: This file is a test class for the LocalizationService in the OrangeHRM project. It contains unit tests for various functionalities such as date formats, language support, language export, XLFF file processing, and error validation related to localization features.

classes.name: LocalizationServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LocalizationService functionalities in the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: testGetLocalizationDateFormats
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of supported date formats with a mocked current date.

methods.name: testGetSupportedLanguages
methods.description: Tests getting the supported languages list from the service.

methods.name: testSearchLanguages
methods.description: Tests searching for languages via the DAO layer.

methods.description: Tests mapping language entities to country array format.
